high_risk_moment: Assistant ranks urgency or suggests a care channel from incomplete user-entered symptoms
harm_description: A proxy, language pattern, or data gap can route similarly serious symptoms differently and delay access to care for an affected group.
existing_controls: The prototype does not use race as an input and has an approved-content library.
proposed_controls: Define clinical outcomes rather than cost or engagement proxies; stratify evaluation by language and clinically relevant subgroup; require escalation when evidence is insufficient.
human_oversight: An independent licensed clinician reviews weekly stratified test outputs and can disable a content path; a triage nurse makes every urgent care disposition.
trigger_threshold: Any subgroup has a missed-red-flag rate above 0.5% or a materially unexplained gap
response_action: Disable the affected flow, investigate data and prompt causes, and require clinician-approved retest before restoration.

high_risk_moment: Assistant responds to symptoms that resemble a configured urgent condition
stakeholder: Adult user and clinic triage nurse
harm_description: An unvalidated response may falsely reassure a user or overload staff with low-value alerts, delaying appropriate care or causing alert fatigue.
existing_controls: Approved red-flag rules and an emergency contact banner are drafted.
proposed_controls: Externally validate red-flag detection against clinician-labeled scripted cases; show uncertainty; route all configured red flags to human review rather than self-care advice.
human_oversight: The triage nurse receives the conversation summary and has authority to contact, redirect, or close the queue; the clinical safety lead can pause the assistant after an unsafe finding.
monitoring_metric: Clinically reviewed unsafe-response and false-negative rate
trigger_threshold: Any emergency red flag ends without routing, or unsafe-response rate exceeds 1 per 1,000 test conversations
response_action: Immediately disable the affected response path, notify clinical safety, review all similar sessions, and publish a corrected approved-content version.

high_risk_moment: User asks for dieting, self-harm, or eating-disorder guidance outside the approved intent
harm_description: Unsafe weight-loss or self-harm-adjacent advice can worsen distress or reinforce harmful behavior in a vulnerable user.
existing_controls: Topic disclaimer and generic emergency links are planned but not demonstrated.
proposed_controls: Block disallowed advice classes, use a crisis-safe response and human referral, red-team adversarial prompts, and audit every safety classifier override.
human_oversight: A clinical safety reviewer samples all blocked and escalated cases daily during research; a nurse or approved helpline—not the model—handles the support handoff and can escalate emergency risk.
monitoring_metric: Unsafe-advice escape rate from adversarial test set
trigger_threshold: Any confirmed unsafe-advice escape or complaint involving self-harm or eating-disorder guidance
response_action: Pause the product, preserve the transcript under privacy protocol, assess affected-user outreach with counsel, and require independent safety sign-off.
